text:
Sam: heads-up — python SDK doesn't expose admin.rate-limits.list; hit it while debugging onboarding sample app, only curl in docs.
Maria: which call?
Sam: tried client.admin.rate_limits.list() -> AttributeError. REST works: curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/rate-limits?org_id=org_123 returns JSON.
Jake: maybe binding missed in generated client. Did OpenAPI include admin routes?
Sam: also noticed SDK retry differs: REST returns 429 + Retry-After header, SDK raises RetryError without exposing Retry-After so our backoff ignores server hint.
Maria: paste repro and logs?
Sam: repro: from redwood import RedwoodClient; client=RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')); client.admin.rate_limits.list(org_id='org_123')
Logs: 2026-03-21 ERROR RetryError: backoff exhausted (cause: 429) -- headers: {"retry-after":"15"} -> SDK not surfacing it.
Jake: two fixes: regen client for binding + add RetryPolicy parsing for Retry-After to surface as RetryError.retry_after. I'll take it.
devex-bot: Issue DEVEX-3781 created and assigned to Jake.
Amira: sample-app calls get_rate_limits() (different name) and models map window_seconds -> window, causing param/shape drift; broke onboarding demo UI.
Maria: I'll add unit test asserting SDK surfaces retry_after and patch sample-app once Jake's PR lands. Also will check TypeScript SDK parity.
Jake: will regen SDKs, add parity checklist in PR, include release instructions and changelog note about window_seconds vs window. ETA EOD.
Sam: noted, leaving support ticket note.
Amira: Dedicated customers with pinned SDKs may need hotfix; will coordinate with release.
Jake: will ping #release-war-room after merge and post follow-up
